title: Method override (synchronous webhook)
summary: Znode calls your endpoint during a core method, lets you change the request or response, or skip the default execution (SkipExecution).
when_to_use: adjust a calculation result (for example totals) without changing Znode code
replace the default behaviour of a supported hook
not_for: any method that is not exposed as a hook: that needs a platform change

contract.message: OverrideZnodeActionEvent: ResponsePayload, ExtendedRequestPayload, WebHookURL, SecretKey, SkipExecution

evidence.note: message shape incl. SkipExecution and SecretKey

limitations: Runs in the request path of a Znode operation: it must be fast and must not fail the call
platform_change_if: the method you need to intercept has no registered hook

unverified: complete list of overridable methods and fields
timeout and failure behaviour of the caller
